system.description: You need a Biotech Tool Kit to modify Yuuzhan Vong Biotech, install a Bio-Implant, or otherwise alter biological devices and Living Vehicles. A standard Biotech Tool Kit consists of a variety of implements and tools that look more at home in a Medical Kit than in a Tool Kit, and unlike a normal Tool Kit, items in a Biotech Tool Kit cannot be doubled as Improvised Weapons.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Legacy Era Campaign Guide
